$comment: Shell-owned action an MFE executes against the domain it is mounted in, to tell the shell two things about workspaces: that one was just created (the shell adds it and makes it current), and that the screen now mounted works inside a workspace (the shell shows the workspace slot). The second is the same shape the project slot already uses: the MFE turns its chrome on, and the shell turns it off by itself when the drawer mounts another screen — see Menu.tsx. An action chain and not an event because an MFE runs in its own module realm and the shell never hears its eventBus.

kind.$comment: created = this workspace now exists and is the one to work in; selected = a screen chose it, so the shell makes it current and moves the session into the workspace level; scoped = the screen that just mounted works inside a workspace, so the slot naming it belongs in the top bar.

workspace.$comment: Required for kind=created and kind=selected. Both carry the name because the sender read the workspace itself and the shell's own list may not hold it yet.
